artworks.label: Moonlit pitcher plant
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for midnight-conservatory. One extraordinary small pitcher plant growing from a compact cushion of dark moss, elegant deep-teal and green sculptural pitcher leaves with pale ivory rims and tiny silver dew beads, one softly curved fresh leaf rising behind. Premium realistic botanical fantasy still-life, moist glossy plant tissue, subtle aged-silver filigree root support, cool moonlit greenhouse illumination, deep teal/emerald/ivory/silver palette. No orchid, glass globe, bell jar, hanging greenhouse, butterfly or window panel. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
